items.stem: What is the nadir one-way delay to a satellite at 600 km?
Roughly how long is a one-way GEO nadir delay?
Why must the lab state geometry = nadir?
choices: Slant range at low elevation is longer, so nadir is a lower bound
Nadir delay is always the worst case
Geometry changes the speed of light

items.stem: Which terrestrial timing assumptions does NTN stretch?
choices: HARQ round trips and timing advance

items.stem: A student submits the 600 km delay with altitude_km = 35786. What happens?
choices: It passes because delay is constant
